question: I was looking up trivia on the Straw Hats, and I found that although they've all been given a favorite food, I can't find anything about their least favorite. So what are each of the Straw Hats' least favorite foods? Cream Nyangoro
answer: Here you go. The reasons are inside the parentheses. [*A certain place's cherry pie (No reason) · *Chocolate (Too sweet) · *Orangette (If she wants fruit, she'll eat regular fruit)  ||  *Mushrooms (Got sick once) · *Konjac (No nutritional value) · *Anything spicy (Not sweet enough)  ||  *Chewing gum (Can't swallow it) · *Marshmallows (Not hard enough) · *Lemon (No cheeks to make a sour face)]
name: Ice Cream Nyangoro
